latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of VN AI Video Editor — fast, cloud-powered video editing and export.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for AI-powered editing.
- Describe your editing needs (trim, transitions, background music) for automated, polished results.
- Export and download 1080p MP4 videos ready for TikTok, Reels, and more.
- Built-in environment/token setup and session management for seamless onboarding.
- Supports batch editing, iterative workflows, and standard formats for input/output.
